title: [1/3] Git Local File History & Content Integration [feat(vc): implement local git history, git show, and github service fetch helpers]
summary: Implement helper methods in VersionControlService to retrieve a single file's commit history and contents at specific SHAs using local git CLI commands.
verifiedNotes:
- Create github_service.dart and define personal access token authorization header handling.
- Implement fetchCommits(String filePath) to retrieve the commit history of a specific file.
- Implement fetchFileContent(String filePath, String commitSha) to pull the raw text of the file.
- Implement getFileCommitHistory(String filePath) using git log --follow --format=%H===%s===%an===%ad --date=iso -- <filePath>
- Implement getFileContentAtCommit(String filePath, String commitSha) using git show <commitSha>:<filePath>
